text: dsh-git-multirepo 是一个面向 DSH Web 会话的多仓库 Git 历史浏览插件。它在会话视图中增加 Repositories 标签页，并在右侧栏打开单个文件的提交差异。插件会扫描当前会话工作目录下的 Git 仓库，将提交合并为一条时间线；用户可以查看当前分支或所有分支、筛选提交、检查仓库状态与远程领先或落后情况、展开提交详情并查看文件差异，也可以手动 fetch 多个仓库。适合在一个工作区管理前端、后端等多个独立仓库并需要集中浏览提交记录的开发者。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 至 0.2.x、Node.js 20+ 和 Git 2.36+；无需额外 API 密钥。
dsh-git-multirepo 的功能「合并多仓库提交」：扫描当前会话工作目录中的 Git 仓库，并把各仓库的提交汇总到同一时间线。用户可切换查看当前分支或全部分支。
dsh-git-multirepo 的功能「查看提交详情与差异」：点击时间线中的提交可读取作者、日期和变更文件，再选择文件在右侧栏查看差异。
dsh-git-multirepo 的功能「检查并拉取仓库更新」：状态视图显示未提交改动及远程领先或落后数量；用户确认后可对发现的仓库执行 fetch 并刷新记录。
dsh-git-multirepo 的功能「筛选提交时间线」：在 Repositories 视图中可按仓库、提交信息、作者、哈希和日期范围缩小显示结果。
能不能在一个页面里看当前分支和所有分支的提交？

我想把工作区里几个独立 Git 仓库的提交放到一条时间线上看。
DSH 有没有页面能同时浏览当前项目目录下多个仓库的日志？
想按仓库、作者、日期或提交信息筛选 Git 记录。
让我在 DSH 里展开一条提交，查看变更文件和具体差异。
I want to compare commit history across several Git repositories in one workspace.
Can I inspect a commit's changed files and open its diff from the DSH session view?

dsh-git-multirepo adds a Repositories tab to DSH web sessions, combining workspace Git commits in one timeline. Browse branches, filter commits, inspect repository status, commit details and file diffs, or manually fetch updates. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 through 0.2.x, Node.js 20+, and Git 2.36+.

dsh-git-multirepo README · dsh-git-multirepo：View commits from several Git repositories together in DSH.

English · [简体中文](https://github.com/drypeek/dsh-git-multirepo/blob/main/README-zh.md)

If a workspace contains separate frontend, backend, or tooling repositories, the **Repositories** tab shows their commits in one timeline. Each commit is labelled with its repository.

This is a third-party plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), with no affiliation to DeepSeek.

dsh-git-multirepo README · Features：- Browse the current branch or all branches. In current-branch mode, incoming remote commits have their own section.
- Expand commit messages and changed files; open a file diff in the right sidebar.
- Filter by repository, date, commit message, author, or short hash.
- Check uncommitted changes and ahead/behind counts, and fetch updates for multiple repositories.

dsh-git-multirepo README · Installation：Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 through 0.2.x, Git 2.36+, and a Node.js 20+ runtime.

Install from npm ([dsh-git-multirepo](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-git-multirepo)). In the DSH desktop app, open **Plugins → Add plugin → Install a third-party plugin** and enter `dsh-git-multirepo`, or run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-git-multirepo
```

dsh-git-multirepo README · Installation：Installation enables the bundle by default; re-enable it on the Plugins page if you previously switched it off. Restart the desktop app after installing or updating; for the Web GUI, refresh the page. The **Repositories** tab then appears beside **Chat** and **Trajectory** in a session.

Other install targets:

dsh-git-multirepo README · Installation：- Prebuilt tarball from the latest GitHub Release:
  ```sh
  dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/drypeek/dsh-git-multirepo/releases/latest/download/dsh-git-multirepo.tgz
  ```
- Local checkout, for development:
  ```sh
  git clone https://github.com/drypeek/dsh-git-multirepo.git
  dsh plugin --profile <profile> add "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-git-multirepo"
  ```

dsh-git-multirepo README · Usage：Open **Repositories** to scan the current session's working directory. Switching sessions changes the directory shown.

Click a commit to expand its details, then click a filename to open its diff. Repository labels control which repositories appear; use search and the date filter to narrow the list.

dsh-git-multirepo README · Usage：| Button | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Refresh | Reread local history and repository status without fetching remote updates. |
| Fetch | Run `git fetch --all --prune` in the discovered repositories, then refresh. When repositories are known, the view asks for confirmation first. |

Fetch does not run `git pull`, merge branches, or update working-tree files. Incoming commits are shown for inspection; merging them is a separate step.
dsh-git-multirepo README · Usage：The chat input is hidden while this tab is open. Switch back to **Chat** to type.

dsh-git-multirepo README · Why is a repository missing?：Check the current session's working directory. By default, discovery scans four levels down and lists up to 100 repositories. It skips hidden directories and dependency/build directories such as `node_modules`, `bin`, `obj`, `dist`, and `target`. The view reports when a scan limit is reached.

dsh-git-multirepo README · Why is older history missing?：The list starts with the latest 40 commits per repository and has total count and size limits. Use `git log` in your terminal to browse the full history. Large commit lists, file lists, and diffs may be truncated or produce an error, with a message in the view.

dsh-git-multirepo README · Why can't a linked worktree be read?：If its main repository is outside the worktree's workspace, register the main repository as a DSH workspace too. Git metadata and object directories must be inside registered workspaces. Repositories sharing objects through `objects/info/alternates` are not currently supported.
section: Why can't a linked worktree be read?

text: dsh-git-multirepo README · What should I do about missing objects in a partial clone?：Commit and diff reads do not fetch missing objects automatically. Try **Fetch** first. If the required objects are still missing, retrieve them in your terminal and reopen the diff.
section: What should I do about missing objects in a partial clone?

dsh-git-multirepo README · Security and privacy：The plugin has no telemetry or analytics. Normal viewing reads local history; Git network transports are enabled only by **Fetch**. The plugin does not commit, push, or merge code.

Fetch uses your existing SSH and Git credential configuration and may run programs configured by a repository. Use it only with repositories you trust. System and global Git configuration are also treated as trusted user configuration.

dsh-git-multirepo README · Security and privacy：DSH handles route authentication, and repository paths are restricted to registered workspaces. See [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/drypeek/dsh-git-multirepo/blob/main/SECURITY.md) for the controls, limitations, and vulnerability reporting process.

dsh-git-multirepo README · Development：From the repository directory, run:

```sh
npm run check
npm test
```

Tests use temporary repositories and local test programs, without contacting external remotes. Both checks also run automatically before `npm publish`.
